task_description: Add Sumopod payment gateway with credit/topup system and auto-refund logic. Users top up credits via Sumopod QRIS, then spend credits on OTP numbers and digital products. Failed fulfilments auto-refund credits.

verification.summary: TypeScript compilation passes cleanly. All 65 tests pass (49 existing + 16 new credit/Sumopod tests). Vite build succeeds. New tests exercise Sumopod gateway createTransaction (mock mode), Svix webhook signature verification (valid/invalid/missing), event type status mapping, factory function, and credit service functions (getBalance, addCredit, debitCredit, refundCredit) with real assertion checks.
